# SWEEPR Deepblock — Zero Ads. Zero Pop-Ups. Browse in Peace.

> SWEEPR Deepblock is an all-in-one browser extension for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and Safari that stops video and banner ads, automatically clicks "No / Reject All" on annoying cookie pop-ups, cleans up cluttered news and recipe pages, hides junk search results, and warns shoppers before they buy from fake scam websites.

## Key Consumer Benefits (Plain-English Overview)
- **Zero Video & Banner Ads:** Blocks pre-roll and mid-roll video ads on YouTube, Twitch, and streaming sites, plus flashing banners and auto-playing video boxes across the web.
- **Automatic Cookie Pop-Up Rejector:** Automatically says "No" to annoying cookie consent banners in under 50 milliseconds on 150+ consent frameworks without breaking page scrolling.
- **Clean Search Results (AI Slop & Junk Filter):** Hides copy-paste junk sites and low-quality filler pages on Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo so you find real answers faster.
- **1-Click Clean Reading View:** Strips away life-story intros, newsletter pop-ups, and floating video boxes on recipe and news sites so you go straight to the article or ingredients.
- **Fake Online Shop Detector (Included Free):** Automatically warns you when an online store looks suspicious—checking for newly registered domains, fake countdown timers, and copied return policies before you enter your card details.
- **Private Browsing & Clean Links (Included Free):** Removes hidden tracking codes from links you click (`utm_`, `fbclid`, `gclid`) and protects your browsing activity.
- **Optional Add-On — Total Tab & RAM Tamer (+£14.99/yr):** Puts inactive background tabs to sleep to free up to 62% of browser memory, stops hidden background scripts from draining laptop battery, and saves open tab sessions against browser crashes.

## Live Anti-Detection Benchmark (8/8 Passed)
SWEEPR Deepblock passes all 8 live browser verification checks on the public Adblock & Anti-Detection Test Lab (`https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab`):
1. Network Ad Request Blocking (Google Ads `adsbygoogle.js`)
2. Cosmetic Bait Honeypot Protection (`adsbox` layout check)
3. Page Scroll Restoration after Cookie Banner Removal
4. YouTube & Video Player Ad Protection
5. Tracking Beacon & Analytics Blocking
6. URL Tracking Parameter Stripping
7. Fake Scam Store Detection Heuristics
8. Zero Browser Fingerprinting Leak
